description: A PostHog data warehouse saved query (view): a named HogQL query that can be queried like a table and optionally materialized on a schedule.

Enabled.description: Whether runs update the table incrementally instead of rebuilding it.

IncrementalKey.description: Output column whose advancing value marks rows as new. Each run reads only rows at or after the last run's highest value for it.

UniqueKey.description: Output columns that identify a row, used to match recomputed rows against stored ones. Must include every GROUP BY column.

LookbackSeconds.description: How far back before the last run's high point to re-read, so late-arriving data is picked up. Only applies when the incremental key is a date or time.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the saved query belongs to.

Name.description: Unique name for the view. Used as the table name in HogQL queries.

Query.description: HogQL query definition as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString) with a "kind" key (always "HogQLQuery") and a "query" key containing the SQL string, e.g. {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT event, count() AS cnt FROM events GROUP BY event"}.

Description.description: What this view represents: what one row is, what the view includes or leaves out, and when to use it.

SyncFrequency.description: How often to materialize this view, or `never` to pause scheduled materialization. Leave unset for no scheduled materialization.

Incremental.description: Update the materialized table in place instead of rebuilding it. Leave unset to rebuild the whole table on every run.

FolderId.description: Optional folder ID used to organize this view in the SQL editor sidebar.

IsTest.description: Whether this view is for testing only and will auto-expire.

AcknowledgeBreakingChanges.description: Confirm an update that removes columns used by downstream views. Without it such an update is refused. Write-only.

Status.description: Materialization status: Cancelled, Modified, Completed, Failed, Running or Skipped.

LastRunAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last materialization run.
